definitions.gloss: the military; military establishment; military leadership
definitions.explanation: The military as an institution or political force, especially its leadership and decision-making apparatus. Often used in historical and political contexts to refer to the military establishment's influence on government.

examples.japanese: {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{介入|かいにゅう}した→介入する：25398_kainyuusuru⟧。

⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発言力|はつげんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}かった→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: In prewar Japan, the military establishment had very strong political influence.

examples.japanese: {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{独走|どくそう}→独走：19974_dokusou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{文民統制|ぶんみんとうせい}→文民統制：24660_bunmintousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{盛|も}り{込|こ}まれた→盛り込む：13608_morikomu⟧。
examples.english: The principle of civilian control was incorporated into the constitution to restrain the military from acting independently.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (military, army) and ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department, section). Refers to the military not as individual soldiers but as an institutional and political force.

USAGE:
Essential for understanding Japanese modern history, especially the period from the Meiji era through World War II. The {軍部|ぐんぶ}'s growing political power in the 1930s is a central topic in Japanese history education. In contemporary contexts, the word may be used when discussing military establishments in other countries as well.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台頭|たいとう}→台頭：07595_taitou⟧: rise of the military
- {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暴走|ぼうそう}→暴走：09481_bousou⟧: the military running out of control
- {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{独走|どくそう}→独走：19974_dokusou⟧: the military acting unilaterally
- {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: the military seizes power
- {軍部|ぐんぶ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧: the military and the government

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧: armed forces; military troops — refers to the actual fighting forces, while {軍部|ぐんぶ} emphasizes the institutional/political aspect
- ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧: army; military — a broader term; {軍部|ぐんぶ} specifically means the military establishment as a political entity
- ⟦{自衛隊|じえいたい}→自衛隊：05790_jieitai⟧: Self-Defense Forces — Japan's postwar military; {軍部|ぐんぶ} is not typically used for the SDF
